purpose: Durable register of remaining work after the quick Worker Inspector prototype. This does not create routing or authority.

non_goals: Not the final Worker Lab information architecture.

pending.title: Compile canonical inspector projection
pending.detail: Build one derived per-worker projection from runtime + beacon + claim + midpoint + result + receipt + exam + external commit clocks. Preserve UNKNOWN when evidence coverage is missing.

pending.title: Define evidence-recency lights
pending.detail: Green/yellow/gray/red must derive from recent durable evidence and expected cadence, never ACTIVE/PARKED/OWNED labels alone. Thresholds should be explicit and run-aware.

pending.title: External stage clocks for all workers
pending.detail: Derive beacon->claim->midpoint->primary->reallocation->close from GitHub/server clocks with coverage states. Do not use model-authored durations as authority.

pending.title: Active vs waiting vs transport time
pending.detail: Aggregate local work, wait, GitHub/transport, retries and tool failures per stage. Keep operation-level measurement local/batched instead of creating one durable write per tool call.

pending.title: Full commit/evidence timeline
pending.detail: Resolve worker-related commits and evidence refs into chronological history with commit time, stage, changed paths and result. Prototype only detects refs/embedded SHAs.

pending.title: Activity pulse chart
pending.detail: Visualize durable worker events over the last 5/30/60 minutes: claims, midpoints, returns, reallocations, closes and boundaries.

pending.title: Throughput and useful-output statistics
pending.detail: Show tasks, useful words, completions and boundaries per rolling window with evidence coverage. Never infer zero from missing data.

pending.title: Run funnel and bottleneck view
pending.detail: Beacon -> claim -> midpoint -> primary -> realloc -> close, with explicit loss classes: admission, persistence, E8 transport, contamination and E9.

pending.title: Capacity heatmap
pending.detail: Render load x condition cells with causal-valid primary/reallocation counts, contamination exclusions and expandable replicas.

pending.title: Recent / all / problems worker views
pending.detail: Prototype has these filters; final version needs persistent sorting, search, mobile treatment and run switching.

pending.title: Single-primary-slot latch
pending.detail: After a worker/nonce wins one RUN primary slot, subsequent primary claims must be impossible/quarantined. MAXCAP exposed one worker claiming six primary slots.

pending.title: Adaptive ceiling search
pending.detail: Compile next ceiling run at 40k/60k/90k/120k x3 with continuation priming frozen, primary-only local workloads, one midpoint and one final result/receipt. If 120k clears, continue geometrically.

pending.title: Continuation priming causal confirmation
pending.detail: 30k signal favors continuation priming but control losses include transport/contamination. Do not declare wording causally superior without cleaner matched evidence.

pending.title: Authenticated private ingress bridge
pending.detail: Primary Chat input remains intentionally draft-only / fail-closed until authenticated private E2E ingress exists. Do not claim send functionality before that.

pending.title: Served browser verification after UI changes
pending.detail: Current chat repair has repo harness/deployment evidence; browser-level visual acceptance should be rerun for the final integrated Worker Lab/Primary Chat state.

pending.title: Notes exact-back / semantic_registry reliability
pending.detail: Prove write -> save -> reload/back -> same note persists. Keep separate from worker observability work unless direct evidence links them.

pending.title: Recover good STT baseline and connect to Notes
pending.detail: Reuse the known good STT branch/candidate, including end-of-recording tail behavior; do not rebuild transcription from scratch.

pending.title: Voice/text -> IDEA/ACTION -> preview -> durable destination
pending.detail: Minimum universal input flow, with typed boundary/command-envelope influence before action dispatch.

pending.title: Productionize local micro-batch packet/result bundle
pending.detail: Use packet -> N local atomic tasks -> verify -> one result bundle, then sparse external I/O. Preserve benchmarking lessons and external timing.

pending.title: Private object encryption canary
pending.detail: One real private object round-trip with authenticated encryption, key outside public GitHub, CAS and receipt. No plaintext public authority.

next_decision: Human reviews Worker Inspector visual prototype. If accepted, implement WLI-001 through WLI-009 by extending existing Worker Lab projection, not by creating a parallel observability architecture.
